messages:
irene: heads-up: were doing a rapid-launch webinar next Wed for APAC + NA. single registration page but split streams per region. need reg copy, CTA test, consent language, and quick clip handoff. can we localize email cadence?

sam_ops: recommend two Zoom meetings (APAC/NA). cloud recording + dual RTMP outputs (primary -> CDN, backup -> s3). OBS fallback VM per region. rotate keys and post in #eng-ops 1h before.

natalie_events: reg page: CTA variants: "watch demo now" vs "request a tailored benchmark". fields: company size, role, timezone preference, explicit checkbox: "I consent to recording reuse". add per-speaker consent checkbox in speaker onboarding. map CTA to HubSpot lists.

ben_creative: post-event deliverables: master mp4 + VTT per session, hero clip (0-90s) + tech clip (90-420s), 1:1 social crops. thumbnails and captions styled. email flows: immediate thanks + slides + 48h private recording; 24h hero; 72h deep clip to engaged viewers. localize subject lines for APAC (JST) and NA (PDT).

legalbot: confirm consent copy: "I consent to Redwood Inference using my session recording and likeness for marketing and product purposes. I understand recordings may be retained for up to 12 months." add opt-out link in emails.

reminderbot: scheduled: speaker reminders 24h and 1h prior; RTMP healthcheck 30m prior; ingest smoke test 20m prior.

irene: quick tech note: use whisper pipeline for captions (disabled Zoom auto-caption). ffmpeg capture snippet for backup: ```ffmpeg -i rtmp://ingest/key -c copy -f segment -segment_time 300 s3://events/rapidlaunch/%Y%m%d-%03d.mp4```

sam_ops: I'll provision VMs and post keys. natalie, can you own localized email cadence? irene, please own UTMs and hubspot mappings.

natalie_events: yes, will do APAC-friendly send windows and translate 2 social snippets for JP/KO. will post draft reg copy in ~30m.
